spec.description:
Autex Quietspace Lattice - Torus is an architectural suspended acoustic baffle
sculpture featuring an abstract, circular woven form. Built from a grid of
intersecting 12mm semi-rigid Cube acoustic fins, its open geometry covers a
greater surface area than traditional parallel baffle systems to effectively
absorb echo and reverberation. Supplied flat-packed with a dedicated suspension
kit, Torus provides Class A acoustic performance (NRC 1.00 / up to 3.90 Sabins
per unit) and Group 1 fire safety for commercial, educational, and hospitality
interiors.
features:
Circular abstract woven form (Torus) creating a
focal ceiling feature

Intersecting grid structure provides high surface area
for optimum sound absorption

Class A acoustic absorption rating (NRC 1.00
/ 1.60 - 3.90 Sabins per unit)

Made from 100% polyester fibre containing a
minimum of 80% recycled PET

Group 1 fire rating compliant with AS ISO 9705
- 2003 and AS 5637.1
Assembled dimensions: 1450 mm x 1450 mm x 293 mm depth

Supplied flat-packed with suspension kit (8 x 1m galvanised cables, ceiling
mounts, clips)

Lightweight and structurally stable; will not sag, warp, or
crumble

Resistant to moisture, mould, and mildew (ASTM G21-15 Growth
Rating: 0)
Certified Carbon Neutral product with third-party verified EPD

install:
Unpack Lattice Torus components and lay out fins on a
clean, protected surface

Slot intersecting 12mm Cube fins together according
to the assembly diagram

Insert alloy tube inserts and Velda cable clips into
designated locking fin slots

Measure and mark suspension anchor points on
ceiling substrate matching cable positions

Fasten ceiling mounts securely to
the structural ceiling or soffit using suitable anchors

Thread 1m galvanised
suspension cables into ceiling mounts and adjust to desired height

Hook
cables into Lattice clips and level the assembled circular Torus sculpture using
a spirit level
selection_checklist:
Confirm ceiling height and
available overhead clearance for 293mm deep profile

Verify ceiling structure
can support 8-point suspension cable attachment

Select colour from the Autex
Cube colour palette (20+ colours)
Check pack quantity requirement (supplied in packs of 2 units)
accessories:
Lattice suspension kit (8 x 1m galvanised cables, 8 x ceiling
mounts, 8 x Velda clips, alloy tube inserts)
limitations:
Indoor ceiling installation only; not suitable for exterior use or wet
environments

Non-load bearing decorative baffle; do not suspend luminaires or
mechanical services from fins

Must be assembled on a clean, soft surface to
avoid scuffing the polyester felt

use_cases:
Suspending directly above
round meeting tables in executive rooms to absorb speech reverberation

Targeted sound control in commercial breakout areas with exposed concrete
soffits

Acoustic and aesthetic ceiling focal point in restaurant dining rooms
and reception lobbies
not_for: Wet rooms with direct water splashing
retrieval.rag_summary:
Autex Quietspace Lattice - Torus is a suspended circular 3D
acoustic baffle sculpture measuring 1450mm x 1450mm x 293mm, constructed from
intersecting 12mm Cube polyester felt fins. By maximizing surface area exposure
to incident sound, it delivers Class A absorption (NRC 1.00 / 1.60 - 3.90 Sabins
per unit) to control echo and speech noise in open-ceiling spaces. Formed
from 100% polyester with at least 80% recycled PET and achieving Group 1 fire
compliance, it provides an expressive, carbon-neutral acoustic ceiling feature
for commercial, civic, and hospitality interiors.
